segment.source: 'Scuse me, ya int'rested in some work?<end>
segment.target: 'Scuse me, ya int'rested in some work?<end>

segment.source: Always. Go on.<end>
segment.target: Always. Go on.<end>

segment.source: Ah, great. <end>
segment.target: Ah, great. <end>

segment.source:
A security company from North Underrail's hirin' folks fer an expedition to the Black Sea. They're lookin' fer laborers, technicians 'n' most importantly skilled fighters - y'know, they need some extra security over there.
Whatever field o' work yer int'rested in, ya gotta be one *tough* pipeworker, 'cause the work's real hardcore - but so's the money, heeee. ::He flashes a toothless grin.::<end>
segment.target:

segment.source: You'll find 'em over at the eastern docks if yer int'rested. <end>
segment.target: You'll find 'em over at the eastern docks if yer int'rested. <end>

segment.source: Just go east along this platform. Can't miss 'em.<end>
segment.target: Just go east along this platform. Can't miss 'em.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Who are these people and what is the expedition about?<end>
segment.target: Who are these people and what is the expedition about?<end>

segment.source: Don't know exactly what they lookin' fer over there. I was just told to direct folks to the docks. ::He shrugs.:: Frankly, I reckon they gotta be diggin' for some old world crap to show off in a museum in Dis. Who cares, long as the pay's good.<end>
segment.target: Don't know exactly what they lookin' fer over there. I was just told to direct folks to the docks. ::He shrugs.:: Frankly, I reckon they gotta be diggin' for some old world crap to show off in a museum in Dis. Who cares, long as the pay's good.<end>

segment.source:
As for the company, it's called *Aegis Incorporated*, 'n' it's from the North. Security contractors - serious business. These guys're packin' a lotta heat, 'n' they look mighty hardcore in 'em full-body armor suits. Oh, yes, siree.
Makes ya... wanna join them straight away, right? Right?<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the Black Sea?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the Black Sea?<end>

segment.source:
Dammit, $(#man/woman), ya ain't from around, are ya? Never heard of the dreaded Black Sea - the Hell's Gut? Spooky legends? Pirates? Y'know, them folks int'rceptin' vessels, zonin' out, kidnappin' plunderin', then takin' their loot to waters few are willin' to chase 'em to?
Don't ring a bell?<end>
segment.target:

Don't ring a bell?<end>

segment.source: Then, well, maybe this sort of work ain't fer ya, kiddo. Just sayin'.<end>
segment.target: Then, well, maybe this sort of work ain't fer ya, kiddo. Just sayin'.<end>

segment.source: When you say *hardcore* money, how hardcore do you mean?<end>
segment.target: When you say *hardcore* money, how hardcore do you mean?<end>

segment.source: I wasn't told *exactly* how hardcore it is, ya dig, but by our Southern standards it's gotta be pretty hardcore. I reckon, if the job's only fer the toughest, right, then the toughest ain't gonna do it cheap. Right, heee?<end>
segment.target: I wasn't told *exactly* how hardcore it is, ya dig, but by our Southern standards it's gotta be pretty hardcore. I reckon, if the job's only fer the toughest, right, then the toughest ain't gonna do it cheap. Right, heee?<end>

segment.source: I'd apply myself, but the ol' legs ain't what they used to be. Nah, they ain't. Rusty pipes they've become, eh.<end>
segment.target: I'd apply myself, but the ol' legs ain't what they used to be. Nah, they ain't. Rusty pipes they've become, eh.<end>

segment.source: So, you're just standing here and directing people down to the docks?<end>
segment.target: So, you're just standing here and directing people down to the docks?<end>

segment.source: Yup. That's my job.<end>
segment.target: Yup. That's my job.<end>

segment.source: ::He leans closer.:: That position's taken. Dig?<end>
segment.target: ::He leans closer.:: That position's taken. Dig?<end>

segment.source: Got it. I'll check them out.<end>
segment.target: Got it. I'll check them out.<end>

segment.source: Hey, got a coin or two? ::He puts his hand out.:: Eh?<end>
segment.target: Hey, got a coin or two? ::He puts his hand out.:: Eh?<end>

segment.source: Sure. ::Give him a stygian coin.::<end>
segment.target: Sure. ::Give him a stygian coin.::<end>

segment.source: Cheers. <end>
segment.target: Cheers. <end>

segment.source: ::He turns away and scans for his next target.::<end>
segment.target: ::He turns away and scans for his next target.::<end>

segment.source: Here's a fiver. ::Give him 5 stygian coins.::<end>
segment.target: Here's a fiver. ::Give him 5 stygian coins.::<end>

segment.source: Cheers! <end>
segment.target: Cheers! <end>

segment.source: Here's a tenner. ::Give him 10 stygian coins.::<end>
segment.target: Here's a tenner. ::Give him 10 stygian coins.::<end>

segment.source: Heee! ::He flashes a toothless grin.:: *Cheers*! <end>
segment.target: Heee! ::He flashes a toothless grin.:: *Cheers*! <end>

segment.source: Sorry.<end>
segment.target: Sorry.<end>

segment.source: Eh. <end>
segment.target: Eh. <end>

segment.source: No. Beat it.<end>
segment.target: No. Beat it.<end>

segment.source: Drop-off! <end>
segment.target: Drop-off! <end>

segment.source: ::Ignore him and leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Ignore him and leave.::<end>

segment.source: I've learned enough.<end>
segment.target: I've learned enough.<end>

segment.source: Alright then. <end>
segment.target: Alright then. <end>

segment.source: Down the main elevator, then east along the platform. Can't miss 'em.<end>
segment.target: Down the main elevator, then east along the platform. Can't miss 'em.<end>

segment.source: Sure. What's this about?<end>
segment.target: Sure. What's this about?<end>

segment.source: Not really, but do go ahead.<end>
segment.target: Not really, but do go ahead.<end>

segment.source: Hey, I'll be brief. <end>
segment.target: Hey, I'll be brief. <end>

segment.source: No. Leave me alone.<end>
segment.target: No. Leave me alone.<end>

segment.source: It's good money! *Real* good money.<end>
segment.target: It's good money! *Real* good money.<end>

segment.source: On the other hand... I could hear you out. Proceed.<end>
segment.target: On the other hand... I could hear you out. Proceed.<end>

segment.source: ::Ignore him and leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Ignore him and leave.::<end>

segment.source: Hey! Go to the east'rn dock if you're int'rested, 'n'-- Oh, drop off.<end>
segment.target: Hey! Go to the east'rn dock if you're int'rested, 'n'-- Oh, drop off.<end>

segment.source: Is this about that expedition to the Black Sea? I already know.<end>
segment.target: Is this about that expedition to the Black Sea? I already know.<end>

segment.source: Oh, oh, alright then. <end>
segment.target: Oh, oh, alright then. <end>

segment.source: 'Scuse me, y-- Oh, it's yer face again. ::Looks away.::<end>
